# ✅ Definition of Done (Checklist before opening PR)

- [ ] **No Direct API Calls:** I used a custom hook for data fetching.
- [ ] **No Hardcoded Colors:** I used `bg-background`, `text-primary`, etc.
- [ ] **Dark Mode Test:** I switched to Dark Mode and nothing looks invisible/weird.
- [ ] **Error Handling:** If the backend fails, the app shows a Toast (not a crash).
- [ ] **Type Safety:** No `any` types used.
- [ ] **Clean Console:** No errors or warnings in the DevTools console.
